newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end first half of 96/97 higher.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end first half of 96/97 higher.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed modestly higher on Monday, with trading remaining quiet on the last day of the first half year of the financial year.
Brokers said the market's attention was shifting to how the key stock index would move from October 1.
The key 225-share Nikkei average finished up 9.38 points or 0.04 percent at 21.556.40. Its September futures gained 70 points to close at 21,570.
"Trading was extremely dull today," said Tetsuya Ishijima, chief strategist at Okasan Securities Co Ltd. "People's focus is rather on stocks' movements from tomorrow."
